a:r.a:t: All endpoints requiring duplicate-request protection must implement idempotency.
Asynchronous message processing for resilience and service decoupling. Supports retry policies and dead-letter handling.
Retry and circuit-breaker policies for external API calls with configuration-driven parameters.
New: process & store. Replay: return cached.
Idempotency prevents data corruption from network retries, client timeouts, and duplicate submissions.
